blocks.text: Sirf aik ya chand nucleotides badalne wali mutations point mutations kehlati hain.

items: Substitution: aik nucleotide doosre se badal jata hai, maslan replication mein A ki jagah G ya C ki jagah T.
Insertion: aik ya zyada izafi nucleotides lag jate hain, aam taur par replication ki ghalti se.
Deletion: aik ya zyada nucleotides nikal jate hain.

blocks.alt: Aik hi DNA aur us ki protein ki chaar qataarein. Normal DNA TAT CAT CCT AAG GTA, protein Tyr-His-Pro-Lys-Val. Substitution TAT CAT CGT AAG GTA, Tyr-His-Arg-Lys-Val. Insertion TAT CAT CGC TAA GGT A, Tyr-His-Arg-Stop. Deletion TAT CTC CTA AGG TA, Tyr-Leu-Leu-Arg-... Badle hue bases aur amino acids surkh hain.

blocks.title: Maloomat: gene mutation
blocks.text: Gene mutation aik gene ki kimiyai banawat mein kisi bhi tabdeeli ki aam istilah hai: chromosome ke bajaye molecular (nucleotide) darje ki tabdeeli. Point mutations sab se aam gene mutations hain.

items: Ionizing radiation: X-rays aur gamma rays bohat mutagenic hain; yeh atoms ko free radicals bana deti hain jo DNA strand ke phosphodiester bonds tor sakte hain.

Ultraviolet radiation: DNA UV ko zor se jazb karta hai; jab do saath wale pyrimidines (C aur T) ise jazb karein to un ke darmiyan covalent bonds bante hain jo replication ko poori tarah rok sakte hain.

Mutagenic kimiyai maadde: kuch nucleotides jaise hote aur DNA mein shamil ho jate hain jo phir theek transcribe nahi hota; kuch adenine ya cytosine se amino group hata dete aur kuch nucleotides par hydrocarbon groups laga dete hain, dono se ghalat joraai hoti hai. Aise maadde laboratories mein use hote aur kabhi mahol mein chhoot jate hain, maslan mustard gas.

Khud-ba-khud mutations: nucleotide mutabadil shakal mein khisak sakta hai to DNA polymerase us ke saath ghalat saathi jor deta hai; ya homologous chromosomes ke jorne par silsile be-tarteeb ho jate, aik chhalla banta aur kaat diya jata hai, jis se aik chromosome se kai sau nucleotides hazf ho jate hain.

blocks.title: Zyada tar mutations nuqsandeh kyun?
blocks.text: Zyada tar mutations genes ke maamool ke kaam mein khalal dalti hain. Haemoglobin mein aik amino acid ki tabdeeli sickle cell anaemia kar sakti hai; gene regulation bigarne wali mutations nashonuma badal kar cancer jaisi bimariyon mein hissa daal sakti hain; aur kuch bekaar ya ghair mustahkam proteins deti hain, jaise phenylketonuria mein.
Point mutations se hone wali bimariyan
Aik gene ki bimariyan autosomal dominant, autosomal recessive ya X-linked tareeqe se virasat mein aati hain. Do ahem misalein yeh hain.

Yeh haemoglobin ki ghair maamooli beta zanjeer ke recessive allele se hai jo chromosome 11 par hai. Mutant allele mein DNA nucleotide T ki jagah A aa jata hai, to glutamic acid ka triplet CTC valine ka CAC ban jata hai (yeh template strand ke triplets hain; coding strand aur mRNA mein GAG se GTG aur GUG). Do mutant alleles wala bachcha ghalat beta zanjeerein banata hai: haemoglobin kam oxygen le jata aur red cells sickle shakal ke ho jate hain. Alamaat mein dard, thakan, saans phoolna, yarqan aur zyada infections shamil hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: normal DNA, coding GAG aur template CTC; nucleotide substitution se GTG aur CAC. Transcription se mRNA codons GAG aur GUG; translation se amino acids ki zanjeer mein glutamic acid aur valine; in se normal gol red blood cell aur darranti (sickle) shakal ka red blood cell.

blocks.text: Ilaaj mein non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) aur opioids se dard mein kami; sehatmand red cells barhane ke liye khoon lagana; bone marrow transplant jo lambe arse ka ilaaj de sakta hai; aur paicheedgiyon se bachne ke liye baqaida nigrani, vaccinations aur antibiotics shamil hain.

Chromosome 12 par normal gene jigar ka enzyme phenylalanine hydroxylase (PAH) banata hai jo amino acid phenylalanine ko tyrosine mein badalta hai. Point mutation, jaise substitution ya deletion, recessive allele banati hai; do recessive alleles wala bachcha kaafi kaam ka PAH nahi banata aur phenylalanine khoon aur tissues mein zehreeli had tak jama ho jata hai. Alamaat mein zehni mazoori, daure, rawaiye ke masail, zehni bimari, microcephaly (chhota sar) aur saans, jild aur peshab ki basi boo shamil hain; zyada phenylalanine dimagh ko nuqsan de sakta hai.

PKU wale log phenylalanine se bhari ghizaon, jaise gosht, doodh ki cheezein, ande aur kuch anaaj, se parhez karte aur khoon ki satah baqaida check kar ke ghiza theek ki jati hai. Kitab kehti hai ke kuch dawaon mein masnooi PAH enzyme hota hai jo khoon ka phenylalanine kam karta hai; supplements woh vitamins aur minerals dete hain jo kam phenylalanine wali ghiza mein kam ho sakte hain.

blocks.title: Genetic bimariyon ke ilaaj ke mumkina tareeqe
blocks.text: Gene therapy kharab gene ko durust ya kaam wale gene se badalti hai. Cell therapy kharab cells ko sehatmand cells se badalti hai, maslan type 1 diabetes mein insulin banane wale beta cells. Pharmacogenomics mareez ke DNA se behtareen dawa chunti hai. Genetic counselling genetic bimari ki tareekh wale khandanon ko testing, maloomat aur khandani mansooba bandi mein rehnumai deti hai.

blocks.prompt: Aik nucleotide ka deletion aam taur par aik nucleotide ki substitution se zyada nuqsan kyun karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Deletion reading frame khiska deta hai, is liye us ke baad har codon badal jata aur aksar jaldi stop aa jata hai; substitution zyada se zyada aik codon badalti hai aur silent bhi ho sakti hai.

items: Asbaab: ionizing aur UV radiation, mutagenic maadde, khud-ba-khud ghaltiyan.
Silent, missense, nonsense; insertion aur deletion se frameshift.
Sickle cell: beta-globin mein Glu se Val (chromosome 11); PKU: kharab PAH (chromosome 12).
